name: n4_list_alarm_classes
description: List the station's alarm classes with their priority per transition ({toOffnormal, toFault, toNormal, toAlert}, 0-255), whether each transition needs an acknowledgement (ack_required), their alarm counts, and the recipients each one routes to. Recipients are the alarm:AlarmRecipient components (console, email, station and others) and a class routes to one through a link from the class's alarm topic to the recipient's routeAlarm action; each class lists {path, type, link_name} of its recipients, recipients lists each recipient with the classes linked to it, and unresolved_links the routeAlarm links whose source is not a listed class. At most 50 recipients are read for links (recipients_truncated says when more exist). A value the station renders in another form is returned as its text. Read-only: two BQL selects at the station root and one tree load per class folder and recipient. audit=true (default false; no extra request) also answers "where do my alarms go": unrouted_classes lists the classes no recipient is linked to (with unrouted_note when a routeAlarm link is unresolved or recipients were left unread, since one of them may route it), audit_counts counts them, and each recipient gains settings, at_default, masked_slots and problems. settings fails closed: a value is returned only for an allowlisted slot of a known type (every recipient type: transitions, daysOfWeek, timeRange, routeAcks; email:EmailRecipient also to, cc, bcc, emailAccount, language; alarm:StationRecipient also remoteStation, lastFailureCause, status, persistent, retryInterval; alarm:ConsoleRecipient also status, defaultTimeRange); every other slot, and every slot of any other recipient type, reads '<set>' or '' and is named in masked_slots. to, cc, bcc and emailAccount of an email recipient and remoteStation of a station recipient read '' when the station omits them at their empty default, named in at_default. problems lists an email recipient with no address in to, cc or bcc or an address that is not an email, a station recipient with no remoteStation, empty transitions or daysOfWeek, an empty url, chatId or webhook slot, a last delivery failure, its text quoted only when lastFailureCause is allowlisted for the type; a problem never quotes a value off the allowlist. To create a class, see the README recipe (n4_create_component, n4_set_slot, n4_create_link).

audit.description: Add unrouted_classes, audit_counts and each recipient's settings and problems
